retraction.reason: Retracted in M22: the presidential election of 23 January 2011, at which Aníbal Cavaco Silva was re-elected in the first round, ten weeks before the request for external assistance. As with every presidential re-election in the imported set, the atlas holds nothing the result can be argued to have changed. The presidency of 2006 to 2016 is unwritten here, and writing it would revive this record and that of 2006 together.
